premises.text: SMBs struggle to interpret energy bills and default to one-off consultants whose reports go stale
premises.evidence_span: he ends up very frustrated and doesn't really know what's going on

premises.text: Energy is a top SMB cost with large missed daily savings opportunities
premises.evidence_span: Energy is one of the top costs for small and medium businesses

premises.text: Drag-and-drop bill upload extracts and organizes all bill data into an analyzed dashboard
premises.evidence_span: all the data contained in those bills is extracted, organized, and analyzed

premises.text: Insights cover cost, consumption, carbon, weather effects, best-in-class benchmarks, and supplier price savings
premises.evidence_span: He can focus in on his data in three primary categories, in cost in the red, in consumption in the blue, and in green for his carbon footprint

premises.text: Smart-meter rollout and building energy-certificate legislation expand data and compliance use cases
premises.evidence_span: with the rollout of smart meters, even larger data sets are going to become available

premises.text: Monetization mixes free bill upload, low per-site subscription, and a utilities/professionals API
premises.evidence_span: We also have an API for utilities and for energy professionals
